summary:
LEARN-01 (roadmap status: design accepted, source in progress, no live experiment started) compares current and focused context by a randomized experiment rather than an optimizer.

- Unit: the original issue (or a predeclared cluster), never the attempt. Assignment is durable before dispatch, so a restart cannot redraw a preferable arm; retries, children and resumed workers inherit it.
- Design: equal allocation, limited blocking on pre-treatment factors such as repository and broad work class; persist algorithm version, unit, probability, block and seed reference before treatment-specific work. Policy learn-01-current-focused-v1 fixes unit original-item, focused probability 0.5, a private window seed digest required before enrollment, and a primary minimum of 6908 independent original items per arm.
- Analysis: assigned-treatment is primary; as-executed is diagnostic. Respect the assignment unit and clustering; with too few clusters, report insufficient precision. A scheduling policy that changes queue behaviour would need a separate cluster or switchback design.
- Telemetry budget (TelemetryBudget.fs): a ratio above 10% breaches, above 25% is severe; intervention is due at 15 distinct breaching items or any severe breach. Unknown counts never pass.

Generic lessons: bandits (N20) and numerics/censored-durations. ADR-0098 §11 tranche 2 (FS-GG/.github#5245) lists this record; the generic technique is a pack entry, the FS-GG instance stays here (§10).
title: LEARN-01 randomized assignment and analysis protocol
